responsibility: This implementation file provides out-of-line support for GCC’s templated vec container. It owns vector memory-usage accounting, allocation-growth heuristics, location-based statistics dumping, qsort comparator consistency checking, and a large set of checking-mode selftests that exercise common vec operations such as push, grow, insert, remove, sorting, reversing, and auto-delete behavior.
same_name_distinction: Holds vec’s out-of-line shared support—memory-usage accounting, growth calculation, statistics dumping, qsort consistency checking, and extensive selftests—whereas gcc/vec.h defines the templated container API and most inline operations.
